items.title: Germany news: Far-right AfD gets first house speaker in a German state parliament
items.description: For the first time since World War II, a far-right party has a house speaker in a German state parliament. And Germany's foreign minister has warned that the climate crisis could fuel extremism. DW has more.

items.title: UK oil refinery broke toxic pollution limits dozens of times, documents reveal
items.description: Pollution was spilled into local rivers and protected sites, documents shared with the BBC suggest.

items.title: Carbon tracking tower put on Scotland's largest saltmarsh
items.description: It will track how much carbon is being taken out of the atmosphere by the saltmarsh on the Solway Firth.

items.title: EU seeks ways to make expansion more palatable to members
items.description: The European Commission has put forward ideas it hopes will both ease the EU expansion process and allay concerns among existing members. Several countries, not least war-torn Ukraine, are among the candidates.
